snippet.title: Lineage II Chronicle 5: Oath of Blood - Third Anniversary CGI Movie - long version
snippet.description:
Each party's determination turns into burning hatred toward each other with sparks flying everywhere. 

The attempt to keep Harne from escaping fails and the battle enters a new phase. 

Meanwhile, on the order of the King of Dark Avent, Outer Council, the Dark Army led by Kaul, raises the flags of death to throw the world in chaos... 

To Be Continued...
